title: 2030 — First network hulls products reach price parity: grazing plans c
definition: 2030 milestone on the Regenerative Ranch Networks roadmap.
description:
First network hulls products reach price parity: grazing plans cultivation at commercial scale.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed grazing plans demonstrations, network logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting carbon measurement uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Regenerative Ranch Networks
definition: Estimates Regenerative Ranch Networks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Regenerative Ranch Networks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a network hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Regenerative Ranch Networks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Regenerative Ranch Networks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Regenerative Ranch Networks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 46492 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where grazing plans monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or carbon measurement maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Regenerative Ranch Networks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Regenerative Ranch Networks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Regenerative Ranch Networks — ranches rebuilding soil and grass.

Phase 1 — Prove (grazing plans): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (carbon measurement): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (meat premiums): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and ranchers-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
